text: det(AB) = det(A) · det(B) for all square matrices A and B of the same size.
explanation: Multiplicativity is a cornerstone theorem: fixing B, the function A ↦ det(AB) is multilinear and alternating in the rows of A, so it must be det(A)·det(B). It gives det(A⁻¹) = det(A)⁻¹ and the similarity invariance det(P⁻¹AP) = det(A).
